## Checklist

- [ ] I edited `content/` only, then ran `npm run format` and `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run check` pass
- [ ] Sentences are natural spoken Hong Kong Cantonese, with Hong Kong Traditional characters
- [ ] Jyutping has tone numbers; I did not type any Yale or Bopomofo by hand
- [ ] Any new content is my own work, or its source and licence are stated

### If this is a review

- [ ] I checked each entry against the [review guide](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/blob/main/docs/REVIEW_GUIDE.md)
- [ ] I added my name to `review.reviewers` only for entries I checked in full
